com_note: Uniform filled-mesh geometric estimate from signed tetrahedra. The wrapper moves the rigid-body frame to its unrotated root, removes the referenced root rigid/mass APIs to avoid nested rigid bodies, and preserves source mesh/colliders. PhysX derives mass properties for the configured 450 g total mass.
